text: The purpose of this report is to make changes to the Fairbank Village, Mount Pleasant and Upper Village Business Improvement Area (BIA) Boards of Management, in accordance with the requirements of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 19, Business Improvement Areas. Fairbank Village, Mount Pleasant and Upper Village Business Improvement Areas fall within two Community Council boundaries.

City Council on March 25 and 26, 2026, adopted the following:hat: 1. City Council, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appoint the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below, at pleasure of Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Fairbank Village: Duseja, Hitesh Klid, Nicholas Mount Pleasant: Persad, Dwayne 2. City Council remove the following directors from the Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below: Fairbank Village: Kremizes, Taso Upper Village: Goodman Boudana, Dr. Melissa
